description.value: Pink Mountain General Store is a critical resupply stop at Mile 143 of the Alaska Highway in one of BC's most remote stretches, operating year-round including in winter. Part of a larger campsite and RV park, it offers an unusually broad range of services for such an isolated location: groceries, fishing supplies, clothing, souvenirs, all fuels, laundry, coin-operated showers, WiFi, a post office, and a liquor outlet. For a touring cyclist on the Alaska Highway, this is a genuine lifeline between very long service gaps.

The phone number (250) 772-5133 matches OSM exactly. The OSM name focuses on the 'General Store' component while the website brands the full property as 'Pink Mountain Campsite & RV Park,' of which the store is one part — worth flagging but not a disqualifying mismatch.
